behavior.description: The red sea urchin is a sea urchin found in the northeastern Pacific Ocean from Alaska to Baja California. It lives in shallow waters from the low-tide line to greater than 280 m (920 ft) deep, and is typically found on rocky shores sheltered from extreme wave action in areas where kelp is available.

sections.section_description: A sea urchin's spherical body is completely covered by sharp spines. These spines grow on a hard shell called the "test", which encloses the animal.  It can vary in color from red to dark burgundy. Rarely,albinospecimens are found. It has a mouth located on its underside, which is surrounded by five teeth.
